verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal lists official SDKs for JavaScript, Java and .NET. These sit alongside a documented API guide covering a first API call, app registration, auth credentials and SMS, so the core of the story is delivered by first-party claims. The evidence amounts to short listing mentions, with no detail on SDK depth or upkeep. Missing for 10: SDK-specific documentation (installation, coverage, versioning, maintenance), SDKs for other major languages such as Python, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
